```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Habit;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class HabitPolicy
{
    use HandlesAuthorization;

    public function viewAny(User $user, Habit $habit)
    {
        // Check if the user is authorized to view any habits.
        return true;
    }

    public function view(User $user, Habit $habit)
    {
        // Check if the user is authorized to view a specific habit.
        return true;
    }

    public function create(User $user, Habit $habit)
    {
        // Check if the user is authorized to create a new habit.
        return true;
    }

    public function update(User $user, Habit $habit)
    {
        // Check if the user is authorized to update an existing habit.
        return true;
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Habit $habit)
    {
        // Check if the user is authorized to delete a specific habit.
        return true;
    }
}
```
